title: Recognize bounded CDP readiness retries
summary: Recognize the bounded CDP readiness-port refusal as an existing single-retry browser-startup transient.
reason: Deep Audit reproduced a browser process that never opened its selected localhost CDP port; the shared runner already permits one retry for CDP startup failures but did not match this precise readiness error shape.
behavior_before: A CDP websocket open error was retried once, while the equivalent bounded readiness timeout ending in localhost ECONNREFUSED failed immediately.
behavior_after: Both explicit CDP startup signatures receive at most one retry; browser console errors, assertions, and non-startup failures still fail immediately.
manual_validation: Bundled-Python browser smoke support suite: 10 passed.
PENDING: hosted Phase 1 and Deep Audit proof.
Ruff on changed Python support and tests: passed.
rollback_plan: Remove the readiness-timeout signature and its regression test, restoring immediate failure for that CDP startup condition.
notes:
The retry remains capped at one and matches the full localhost ECONNREFUSED readiness signature. ERR_NO_BUFFER_SPACE, console noise, and product assertions remain actionable failures.
